text: A string is attached to a block of weight 30 N, which is in contact with a rough horizontal plane.
When the string is horizontal and the tension in it is 24 N, the block is in limiting equilibrium.
A and B are two points 50 metres apart on a straight path inclined at an angle  to the horizontal,
where sin  = 0.05, with A above the level of B. A block of mass 16 kg is pulled down the path from
A to B. The block starts from rest at A and reaches B with a speed of 10 m s . The work done by the
pulling force acting on the block is 1150 J.
